subject: Portfolio clarity check — upcoming renewals & stage hygiene
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Portfolio clarity check — upcoming renewals & stage hygiene

Team —

Quick request as we close Q3 planning: I want a short, inventory-style update for the handful of mid-size customers that sit in the July–Sep renewal window (Acme Corp, BrightRetail, Northside Labs). Goal is to get each account into one of three buckets by EOD Monday: green (on-track/committed), yellow (needs outreach/exec touch), red (at-risk — requires finance or product concessions).

For Acme specifically, please confirm: renewal date, current committed ARR, stage in our pipeline (Proposal/Final/Contracting), primary churn signals (usage, spend velocity, stakeholder changes), and any active procurement blockers. Attach a one-line recommended next step and an owner.

I attached a single-row rollup template (acme_renewal_rollup.xlsx) — drop the values directly into it and reply. We’ll consolidate into the forecast and decide whether to include in the commit for July.

Thanks — short notes welcome, no long essays.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Sr. Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>

Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 10:05:00 -0700

On Wed, Jul 1, 2026 at 9:12 AM Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com> wrote:
> Team —
> Quick request as we close Q3 planning: I want a short, inventory-style update for the handful of mid-size customers that sit in the July–Sep renewal window (Acme Corp, BrightRetail, Northside Labs).

Marcus — short answers below for Acme:
- Renewal date: 2026-08-15
- Committed ARR: $265,000
- Pipeline stage: Contracting (SOW in counters)
- Churn signals: 20% drop in monthly token consumption last 6 weeks; two PoC features not adopted; new Head of Data (hired June) replacing old champion
- Procurement blockers: Procurement requested updated SOW and SOC2 evidence; legal asked for a data processing addendum change (we flagged to Legal)
- Recommended next step: Exec briefing with new Head of Data + provide reuse-case playbook; ask for a Firm Renewal Date by 07/10
- Owner: Laura Bennett (AM)

I attached a filled row in the rollup and a quick usage chart snapshot.

Laura Bennett
Account Manager, Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, laura.bennett@redwood.com, monica.patel@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 02 Jul 2026 11:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Portfolio clarity check — upcoming renewals & stage hygiene

Thanks Laura — added a quick risk score and action suggestion.

Risk scoring (Acme): 7/10 — medium-high. Rationale: usage decline + stakeholder change. Likelihood of churn without intervention ~35%.
Suggested playbook (concise):
1) Schedule 30-min exec briefing (Marcus/Laura + new Head of Data) by 07/09.
2) Offer a conditional usage credit (3 months, capped at $15k) contingent on signed renewal by 08/15. Finance sign-off required; I can route a one-time credit approval if Sales Ops agrees.
3) Deliver two adoption templates and a 2-week enablement sprint to target the unused PoC features (owner: Customer Success).

If we want to include Acme in the July commit, we need a signed SOW by 07/10 or a written commitment from Procurement on timing. Otherwise, mark as forecast but not commit.

Karthik
Head of Renewals Strategy
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Date: Fri, 03 Jul 2026 08:45:00 -0700
Subject: Quick check-in on Acme renewal timing

Liz —

Hope you’re doing well. Quick and direct: we’re preparing the July commit forecast and wanted to confirm Acme’s intention on the August 15 renewal. Your AM (Laura) has been in touch with procurement about SOW updates and legal redlines. Can you confirm whether Procurement expects to sign by 07/10, or whether Procurement needs more time?

If you need anything from us to unblock (SOW draft, SOC2 evidence, a brief exec call to align on post-renewal roadmap), tell me and we’ll coordinate immediately.

Thanks for the quick read — appreciate it.

Marcus Lin
Sr. Director, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

> Hope you’re doing well. Quick and direct: we’re preparing the July commit forecast and wanted to confirm Acme’s intention on the August 15 renewal.

Marcus / Laura — thanks for the nudge. Procurement is reviewing the SOW and our legal team returned a few redlines (see attached SOW_v3_redlines.pdf). We expect to finish internal review by 07/09 but cannot guarantee sign-off by 07/10 — there is one data-retention clause that needs final confirmation from our compliance team.

High level ask from our side: can Redwood provide a short note on data retention defaults (1 page) and a proposed one-year timeline for the post-renewal enablement plan? That will help accelerate compliance review.

We are committed to continuing the relationship and hope to sign, but procurement timing may push us out of the tight July commit window. I’ll update as soon as I have clearance.

Best,

Account: Acme Corporation

- Risk bucket: Yellow (needs exec touch; not yet lost)

- Immediate actions:

  * Marcus to prepare 1-pg data retention note and an outline of the 1-year enablement roadmap — owner: Marcus Lin — deliver by 07/07 (linked: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0AexampleSharedDriveId).
  * Karthik to draft conditional credit terms for Finance approval (cap $15k) — owner: Karthik Iyer — deliver draft by 07/07 and route to Finance via FIN-1234 ticket.
  * CSM to prepare adoption sprint template (owner: Customer Success) — deliver by 07/12.

Attachments included for the record: acme_renewal_rollup.xlsx, SOW_v3_redlines.pdf. I’ll update the forecast tracker once Laura confirms exec meeting time or we receive a procurement sign-date.
